PREFIX ex: <https://spinach.local/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?personLabel ?colleague ?colleagueLabel WHERE {
  ?person ex:collaboratesWith ?colleague ; ex:worksAt ?inst1 ; ex:participatesIn ?project ; ex:authored ?paper .
  ?colleague ex:worksAt ?inst2 ; ex:participatesIn ?project ; ex:authored ?paper .
  ?inst1 ex:locatedIn ?city1 . ?city1 ex:country ?country1 .

  ?paper ex:status ex:published .
